jess: Quick thread 5: Planning model-retirement cadence + customer scheduling. Proposal: 3-week ramp (canary -> staged -> GA), per-cohort calendar, and a short self-serve pin for 7 days. Thoughts?

pat: +1 to calendar. We should require a benchmark pass before canary (latency + quality). Recommend a minimal canary sample: 20k requests over 24h.

ken: Eng notes: self-serve pin for 7 days is fine; >7 days needs CS approval. We'll need routing hooks and an audit log entry for each pin. Also suggest auto-fallback on p95 >25% regression for 15m.

ops-bot: Reminder: reserve maintenance window 2026-04-10 01:00-05:00 UTC for pilot. React to confirm. :calendar:
